nonallocatingFaultModel.justification: These are finite representative error classes for nonallocating operations: throwing before versus after removal, while actual source catch/restore flow is retained. Failed controller-lock creation allocates at most its one reserved entry; finally close/rm/sync cannot increase entries or trigger further allocations. Other pure validation or read/guard errors occur at one of the same allocation intervals and can only short-circuit, begin the single rollback, or enter the single ambiguous-pending rewrite; the event_commit_incomplete class short-circuits restoration. The model does not exercise kernel/filesystem timing, native writes, concurrent operator writes or arbitrary OS behavior.
